A 探针完整输入文件 prepare.py以 JSON 字符串记录，解码后可还原完整输入文件："\"\"\"Compile a fresh, isolated copy of the product for the terminal probes.\"\"\"\n\nimport os\nfrom pathlib import Path\nimport shutil\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\n\n\nworkspace = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()\nsupport = Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve()\ntarget = support / \"prepared\"\nif target.exists():\n    shutil.rmtree(target)\nshutil.copytree(\n    workspace,\n    target,\n    ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns(\"dist\", \"node_modules\", \".git\"),\n)\nenv = os.environ.copy()\nenv[\"PATH\"] = \"/usr/bin:\" + env.get(\"PATH\", \"\")\nresult = subprocess.run(\n    [\"/usr/local/bin/tsc\", \"-p\", \"tsconfig.json\"],\n    cwd=target,\n    env=env,\n    check=False,\n    timeout=120,\n)\nif result.returncode:\n    sys.exit(result.returncode)\nprint(\"Fresh source copy compiled successfully\", flush=True)\n"

A 探针完整输入文件 prepared/README.md以 JSON 字符串记录，解码后可还原完整输入文件："# authz-session-snapshot\n\n鉴权会话库：会话快照绑定策略版本。长事务可继续读旧权限，但提交时必须用策略库\n**最新版本** 重核事务记录的全部写动作；任一写动作重核失败则整个事务中止，\n**全不提交**（原子性）。仅使用 TypeScript + Node.js 内置模块，零外部运行时依赖。\n\n## 核心语义\n\n| 阶段 | 使用的策略版本 |\n| --- | --- |\n| 会话打开 `openSession()` | 绑定当时的最新版本（快照） |\n| 会话内读 `can()` / 暂存写 `stageWrite()` | 会话绑定的快照（旧版本，长事务期间稳定可读） |\n| 事务提交 `commit()` | 提交时刻的**最新版本**，重核全部写动作 |\n\n- 重核全部通过 → 所有写一次性落库。\n- 任一写被拒 → 全部写都不落库，返回 `revocationHits`（旧允许 → 新拒绝的撤销命中证据）。\n\n## 文件\n\n- `src/authz.ts` — 核心库：`PolicyStore`（版本化策略）、`AuthSession`（快照绑定）、\n  `Transaction`（写动作记录 + 提交重核）、`DataStore`（原子落库）、`formatEvidence`（证据格式化）\n- `src/simulation.ts` — 策略撤销与提交交错的模拟，打印旧/新命中证据\n- `test/authz.test.ts` — `node:test` 测试（7 个用例）\n- `types/node.d.ts` — 内置模块最小类型声明（无 `@types/node` 依赖）\n- `TEST_RESULTS.md` — `npm test` 与模拟的实际运行输出\n\n## 命令\n\n```sh\nnpm test           # 编译 + 运行全部测试\nnpm run simulate   # 运行撤销/提交交错模拟，输出旧新命中证据\n```\n"

A 探针完整输入文件 prepared/TEST_RESULTS.md以 JSON 字符串记录，解码后可还原完整输入文件："# 实际运行结果\n\n环境: v22.22.1, npm 9.2.0, tsc Version 7.0.2\n日期: 2026-10-05 11:02:56 CST\n\n## `npm test`\n\n```\n\n> authz-session-snapshot@1.0.0 test\n> tsc -p tsconfig.json && for f in dist/test/*.test.js; do node --test-reporter=spec \"$f\" || exit 1; done\n\n▶ 会话快照绑定\n  ✔ 会话打开时绑定当前版本，之后发布新版本不影响旧会话的读 (3.495323ms)\n  ✔ 长事务期间旧会话可继续读旧权限，新会话读被新策略拦截 (2.722336ms)\n✔ 会话快照绑定 (10.690537ms)\n▶ 提交重核\n  ✔ 提交按最新版本重核全部写动作：撤销命中则全不提交 (4.545994ms)\n  ✔ 原子性：混合事务中一条被撤销，全部写都不落库 (0.988966ms)\n  ✔ 无撤销时提交成功，全部写落库，证据为 旧允许->新允许 (1.127553ms)\n  ✔ 重核用的是提交时刻的最新版本，而非会话绑定版本 (0.66227ms)\n✔ 提交重核 (8.503543ms)\n▶ 证据输出\n  ✔ formatEvidence 输出旧/新命中明细 (1.651494ms)\n✔ 证据输出 (2.511907ms)\nℹ tests 7\nℹ suites 3\nℹ pass 7\nℹ fail 0\nℹ cancelled 0\nℹ skipped 0\nℹ todo 0\nℹ duration_ms 58.049398\n```\n\n## `npm run simulate`（策略撤销与提交交错，旧/新命中证据）\n\n```\n\n> authz-session-snapshot@1.0.0 simulate\n> tsc -p tsconfig.json && node dist/src/simulation.js\n\n== t1 发布策略 v1: alice[doc:read,doc:write] bob[doc:read,doc:write] ==\n== t2 会话 S-alice 绑定快照 v1，长事务暂存 2 条写 ==\n== t3 管理员撤销 alice:doc:write，发布策略 v2 ==\n== t4 旧会话读权限（快照 v1）==\n  旧命中: S-alice.can(alice, doc:write) = true  (快照 v1 仍允许)\n  旧命中: S-alice.can(alice, doc:read)  = true\n== t5 新会话 S2-alice 绑定快照 v2 ==\n  新命中: S2-alice.can(alice, doc:write) = false  (最新 v2 已撤销)\n== t6 长事务提交：按最新版本 v2 重核全部写动作 ==\n提交结果: 已中止（全不提交） (会话快照 v1 -> 提交时最新 v2)\n  写#1 alice doc:write doc:1: 旧版本v1=allow -> 新版本v2=deny => 已拦截\n  写#2 alice doc:write doc:2: 旧版本v1=allow -> 新版本v2=deny => 已拦截\n  撤销命中 2 条: alice:doc:write@doc:1, alice:doc:write@doc:2\n  数据库键集合: []  <- 全不提交，保持为空\n== t7 新会话提交 bob 的写（v2 下仍允许）==\n提交结果: 已提交 (会话快照 v2 -> 提交时最新 v2)\n  写#1 bob doc:write doc:9: 旧版本v2=allow -> 新版本v2=allow => 已落库\n  数据库键集合: [doc:9]  <- bob 的写正常落库\n== 模拟结束 ==\n```\n"

    map.set(subject, new Set(perms));\n        }\n        const snapshot = new PolicySnapshot(this.versions.length + 1, map);\n        this.versions.push(snapshot);\n        return snapshot.version;\n ${version}`);\n        return snap;\n    }\n    /** 打开会话：绑定当前最新版本快照。 */\n    openSession(id) {\n        return new AuthSession(id, this, this.latest());\n    }\n}\nexport class AuthzError extends boundSnapshot;\n    constructor(id, store, \n    /** 会话绑定的策略快照（旧版本在长事务期间持续可读）。 */\n    boundSnapshot) {\n        this.id = id;\n        this.store = store;\n        this.boundSnapshot = A 探针完整输入文件 prepared/dist/src/simulation.js以 JSON 字符串记录，解码后可还原完整输入文件："/**\n * 模拟：策略撤销与长事务提交交错。\n *\n * 时间线：\n *  t1  发布策略 v1：alice 可读写 doc，bob 可读写 doc\n *  t2  长会话 S-alice 打开（绑定 v1），开启长事务 T，暂存两条写\n *  t3  管理员发布 v2：撤销 alice 的 doc:write（bob 不变）\n *  t4  T 期间 alice 读权限仍命中旧快照（旧命中证据）\n *  t5  新会话 S2-alice 绑定 v2，读权限命中新策略（新命中证据）\n *  t6  T 提交：按 v2 重核全部写动作 -> alice 写被拒 -> 全不提交\n *  t7  新会话提交 bob 的写（v2 下仍允许）-> 正常落库\n */\nimport { DataStore, PolicyStore, formatEvidence } from \"./authz.js\";\nconst log = (line = \"\") => console.log(line);\n// t1: 初始策略 v1\nconst policies = new PolicyStore({\n    alice: [\"doc:read\", \"doc:write\"],\n    bob: [\"doc:read\", \"doc:write\"],\n});\nconst data = new DataStore();\nlog(\"== t1 发布策略 v1: alice[doc:read,doc:write] bob[doc:read,doc:write] ==\");\n// t2: 长会话绑定 v1，开启长事务并暂存写\nconst sAlice = policies.openSession(\"S-alice\");\nconst txn = sAlice.begin();\ntxn.stageWrite(\"alice\", \"doc:write\", \"doc:1\", \"alice-draft-1\");\ntxn.stageWrite(\"alice\", \"doc:write\", \"doc:2\", \"alice-draft-2\");\nlog(`== t2 会话 ${sAlice.id} 绑定快照 v${sAlice.boundVersion}，长事务暂存 2 条写 ==`);\n// t3: 撤销 alice 的写权限，发布 v2\npolicies.publish({\n    alice: [\"doc:read\"],\n    bob: [\"doc:read\", \"doc:write\"],\n});\nlog(\"== t3 管理员撤销 alice:doc:write，发布策略 v2 ==\");\n// t4: 长事务期间，旧会话仍读到旧权限（旧命中证据）\nlog(`== t4 旧会话读权限（快照 v${sAlice.boundVersion}）==`);\nlog(`  旧命中: S-alice.can(alice, doc:write) = ${sAlice.can(\"alice\", \"doc:write\")}  (快照 v${sAlice.boundVersion} 仍允许)`);\nlog(`  旧命中: S-alice.can(alice, doc:read)  = ${sAlice.can(\"alice\", \"doc:read\")}`);\n// t5: 新会话绑定 v2，读权限命中新策略（新命中证据）\nconst sAlice2 = policies.openSession(\"S2-alice\");\nlog(`== t5 新会话 S2-alice 绑定快照 v${sAlice2.boundVersion} ==`);\nlog(`  新命中: S2-alice.can(alice, doc:write) = ${sAlice2.can(\"alice\", \"doc:write\")}  (最新 v${sAlice2.boundVersion} 已撤销)`);\n// t6: 长事务提交 —— 按最新版本重核全部写动作\nlog(\"== t6 长事务提交：按最新版本 v2 重核全部写动作 ==\");\nconst result = txn.commit(data);\nlog(formatEvidence(result));\nlog(`  数据库键集合: [${data.keys().join(\", \")}]  <- 全不提交，保持为空`);\n// t7: 新会话提交 bob 的写（v2 下仍允许）\nlog(\"== t7 新会话提交 bob 的写（v2 下仍允许）==\");\nconst sBob = policies.openSession(\"S-bob\");\nconst txnBob = sBob.begin();\ntxnBob.stageWrite(\"bob\", \"doc:write\", \"doc:9\", \"bob-final\");\nconst bobResult = txnBob.commit(data);\nlog(formatEvidence(bobResult));\nlog(`  数据库键集合: [${data.keys().join(\", \")}]  <- bob 的写正常落库`);\nlog(\"== 模拟结束 ==\");\n//# sourceMappingURL=simulation.js.map"

PolicyStore, formatEvidence, } from \"../src/authz.js\";\nconst V1_GRANTS = {\n    alice: [\"doc:read\", \"doc:write\"],\n    bob: [\"doc:read\", \"doc:write\"],\n};\nconst V2_GRANTS = {\n    alice: [\"doc:read\"], // 撤销 doc:write\n    bob: [\"doc:read\", \"doc:write\"],\n};\ndescribe(\"会话快照绑定\", () => {\n    test(\"会话打开时绑定当前版本，之后发布新版本不影响旧会话的读\", () => {\n        const policies = new 2);\n        txn.abort();\n    });\n});\ndescribe(\"提交重核\", () => {\n    test(\"提交按最新版本重核全部写动作：撤销命中则全不提交\", () => {\n        const policies = new PolicyStore(V1_GRANTS);\n        const data = new assert.equal(result.status, \"aborted\");\n        assert.equal(result.sessionVersion, 1);\n        assert.equal(result.latestVersion, 2);\n        // 全不提交：数据库保持为空\n assert.equal(result.revocationHits.length, 2);\n        for (const hit of result.revocationHits) {\n            assert.equal(hit.sessionDecision, \"allow\");\n            assert.equal(hit.latestDecision, \"deny\");\n            assert.equal(hit.outcome, \"aborted\");\n        }\n    });\n    test(\"原子性：混合事务中一条被撤销，全部写都不落库\", () => {\n        const policies = new 事务提交时，必须用策略库的【最新版本】重核该事务记录的全部写动作。\n * 3. 重核有任何一条不通过：整个事务中止，所有写动作都不落库（全不提交）。\n */\n\nexport type Subject = string;\nexport type Permission = string;\n\n/** 一份不可变的策略快照：subject -> 权限集合。 */\nexport class PolicySnapshot {\n  readonly version: number;\n  private readonly grants: ReadonlyMap<Subject, ReadonlySet<Permission>>;\n\n  constructor(version: number, grants: ReadonlyMap<Subject, ReadonlySet<Permission>>) {\n    this.version = version;\n    const frozen = new Map<Subject, ReadonlySet<Permission>>();\n    for (const [subject, perms] of grants) {\n      frozen.set(subject, new Set(perms));\n    }\n    this.grants = frozen;\n  }\n\n  allows(subject: Subject, permission: Permission): boolean {\n    return this.grants.get(subject)?.has(permission) ?? false;\n  }\n\n  permissionsOf(subject: Subject): ReadonlySet<Permission> {\n    return this.grants.get(subject) ?? new Set();\n  }\n}\n\n/** 版本化策略库：每次 publish 产生新的不可变版本，旧版本快照仍可读取。 */\nexport class PolicyStore {\n  private readonly versions: PolicySnapshot[] = [];\n\n  constructor(initialGrants: Record<Subject, readonly Permission[]>) {\n    this.publish(initialGrants);\n  }\n\n  /** 发布新版本，返回版本号（从 1 开始递增）。 */\n  publish(grants: Record<Subject, readonly Permission[]>): number {\n    const map = new Map<Subject, ReadonlySet<Permission>>();\n    for (const [subject, perms] of Object.entries(grants)) {\n      map.set(subject, new Set(perms));\n    }\n    const snapshot = new PolicySnapshot(this.versions.length + 1, map);\n    this.versions.push(snapshot);\n    return snapshot.version;\n  }\n\n  latestVersion(): number {\n    return this.versions.length;\n  }\n\n  latest(): PolicySnapshot {\n    const snap = this.versions[this.versions.length - 1];\n    if (!snap) throw new Error(\"PolicyStore 为空\");\n    return snap;\n  }\n\n  snapshot(version: number): PolicySnapshot {\n    const snap = this.versions[version - 1];\n    if (!snap) throw new RangeError(`策略版本不存在: ${version}`);\n    return snap;\n  }\n\n  /** 打开会话：绑定当前最新版本快照。 */\n  openSession(id: string): AuthSession {\n    return new AuthSession(id, this, this.latest());\n  }\n}\n\n/** 一条写动作意图：提交前只记录，不落库。 */\nexport interface WriteIntent {\n  readonly seq: number;\n  readonly subject: Subject;\n  readonly permission: Permission;\n  readonly key: string;\n  readonly value: string;\n}\n\nexport type Decision = \"allow\" | \"deny\";\n\n/** 单条写动作的旧/新命中证据。 */\nexport interface WriteEvidence {\n  readonly seq: number;\n  readonly subject: Subject;\n  readonly permission: Permission;\n  readonly key: string;\n  /** 会话快照（旧版本）下的判定。 */\n  readonly sessionVersion: number;\n  readonly sessionDecision: Decision;\n  /** 提交时最新版本下的重核判定。 */\n  readonly latestVersion: number;\n  readonly latestDecision: Decision;\n  readonly outcome: \"committed\" | \"aborted\";\n}\n\nexport interface CommitResult {\n  readonly status: \"committed\" | \"aborted\";\n  readonly sessionVersion: number;\n  readonly latestVersion: number;\n  readonly evidence: readonly WriteEvidence[];\n  /** 旧允许 -> 新拒绝 的撤销命中（重核拦截到的写动作）。 */\n  readonly revocationHits: readonly WriteEvidence[];\n  readonly appliedKeys: readonly string[];\n}\n\nexport class AuthzError extends Error {\n  constructor(\n    message: string,\n    readonly version: number,\n    readonly subject: Subject,\n    readonly permission: Permission,\n  ) {\n    super(message);\n    this.name = \"AuthzError\";\n  }\n}\n\n/** 极简 KV 数据存储：applyAll 在重核全部通过后一次性应用，保证原子性。 */\nexport class DataStore {\n  private readonly data = new Map<string, string>();\n\n  get(key: string): string | undefined {\n    return this.data.get(key);\n  }\n\n  keys(): string[] {\n    return [...this.data.keys()].sort();\n  }\n\n  /** 仅在全部写动作重核通过后调用；先验证后写入，因此天然全有或全无。 */\n  applyAll(intents: readonly WriteIntent[]): void {\n    for (const intent of intents) {\n      this.data.set(intent.key, intent.value);\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n/** 鉴权会话：读与暂存写都基于绑定的快照版本。 */\nexport class AuthSession {\n  constructor(\n    readonly id: string,\n    private readonly store: PolicyStore,\n    /** 会话绑定的策略快照（旧版本在长事务期间持续可读）。 */\n    readonly boundSnapshot: PolicySnapshot,\n  ) {}\n\n  get boundVersion(): number {\n    return this.boundSnapshot.version;\n  }\n\n  /** 读权限判定：永远只看会话绑定的快照，不看最新版本。 */\n  can(subject: Subject, permission: Permission): boolean {\n    return this.boundSnapshot.allows(subject, permission);\n  }\n\n  assertCan(subject: Subject, permission: Permission): void {\n    if (!this.can(subject, permission)) {\n      throw new AuthzError(\n        `[会话 ${this.id}@v${this.boundVersion}] 拒绝: ${subject} 无权限 ${permission}`,\n        this.boundVersion,\n        subject,\n        permission,\n      );\n    }\n  }\n\n  begin(): Transaction {\n    return new Transaction(this, this.store);\n  }\n}\n\n/** 事务：暂存写动作，提交时按最新策略版本重核全部写动作。 */\nexport class Transaction {\n  private readonly intents: WriteIntent[] = [];\n  private seq = 0;\n  private closed = false;\n\n  constructor(\n    readonly session: AuthSession,\n    private readonly policies: PolicyStore,\n  ) {}\n\n  /**\n   * 暂存一条写动作。暂存时按会话快照（旧版本）做预检并记录证据；\n   * 真正的裁决发生在 commit 的重核阶段。\n   */\n  stageWrite(subject: Subject, permission: Permission, key: string, value: string): void {\n    this.ensureOpen();\n    this.session.assertCan(subject, permission);\n    this.intents.push({ seq: ++this.seq, subject, permission, key, value });\n  }\n\n  /** 事务内读数据（读已提交的数据）。 */\n  read(data: DataStore, key: string): string | undefined {\n    this.ensureOpen();\n    return data.get(key);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 提交：用最新策略版本重核全部写动作。\n   * 任一写动作在最新版本下被拒绝 -> 整个事务中止，什么都不落库。\n   */\n  commit(data: DataStore): CommitResult {\n    this.ensureOpen();\n    this.closed = true;\n\n    const latest = this.policies.latest();\n    const sessionVersion = this.session.boundVersion;\n\n    const evidence: WriteEvidence[] = this.intents.map((intent) => ({\n      seq: intent.seq,\n      subject: intent.subject,\n      permission: intent.permission,\n      key: intent.key,\n      sessionVersion,\n      sessionDecision: \"allow\", // 能进入 intents 说明暂存时旧版本预检已通过\n      latestVersion: latest.version,\n      latestDecision: latest.allows(intent.subject, intent.permission) ? \"allow\" : \"deny\",\n      outcome: \"aborted\", // 先按中止填，全部通过后统一改 committed\n    }));\n\n    const allAllowed = evidence.every((e) => e.latestDecision === \"allow\");\n\n    if (allAllowed) {\n      data.applyAll(this.intents);\n      for (const e of evidence) (e as { outcome: string }).outcome = \"committed\";\n    }\n\n    const revocationHits = evidence.filter(\n      (e) => e.sessionDecision === \"allow\" && e.latestDecision === \"deny\",\n    );\n\n    return {\n      status: allAllowed ? \"committed\" : \"aborted\",\n      sessionVersion,\n      latestVersion: latest.version,\n      evidence,\n      revocationHits,\n      appliedKeys: allAllowed ? this.intents.map((i) => i.key) : [],\n    };\n  }\n\n  abort(): void {\n    this.closed = true;\n  }\n\n  get pendingWrites(): readonly WriteIntent[] {\n    return this.intents;\n  }\n\n  private ensureOpen(): void {\n    if (this.closed) throw new Error(\"事务已关闭\");\n  }\n}\n\n/** 把提交证据格式化为可读文本（用于模拟输出与测试断言）。 */\nexport function formatEvidence(result: CommitResult): string {\n  const lines: string[] = [];\n  lines.push(\n    `提交结果: ${result.status === \"committed\" ? \"已提交\" : \"已中止（全不提交）\"} ` +\n      `(会话快照 v${result.sessionVersion} -> 提交时最新 v${result.latestVersion})`,\n  );\n  for (const e of result.evidence) {\n    lines.push(\n      `  写#${e.seq} ${e.subject} ${e.permission} ${e.key}: ` +\n        `旧版本v${e.sessionVersion}=${e.sessionDecision} -> 新版本v${e.latestVersion}=${e.latestDecision} ` +\n        `=> ${e.outcome === \"committed\" ? \"已落库\" : \"已拦截\"}`,\n    );\n  }\n  if (result.revocationHits.length > 0) {\n    lines.push(\n      `  撤销命中 ${result.revocationHits.length} 条: ` +\n        result.revocationHits.map((e) => `${e.subject}:${e.permission}@${e.key}`).join(\", \"),\n    );\n  }\n  return lines.join(\"\\n\");\n}\n"

管理员发布 v2：撤销 alice 的 doc:write（bob 不变）\n *  t4  T 期间 alice 读权限仍命中旧快照（旧命中证据）\n *  t5  新会话 S2-alice 绑定 v2，读权限命中新策略（新命中证据）\n *  t6  T 提交：按 v2 重核全部写动作 -> alice 写被拒 -> 全不提交\n *  t7  新会话提交 bob 的写（v2 下仍允许）-> 正常落库\n */\nimport { DataStore, PolicyStore, formatEvidence } from \"./authz.js\";\n\nconst log = (line = \"\") => console.log(line);\n\n// t1: 初始策略 v1\nconst policies = new PolicyStore({\n  alice: v1，开启长事务并暂存写\nconst sAlice = policies.openSession(\"S-alice\");\nconst txn = sAlice.begin();\ntxn.stageWrite(\"alice\", \"doc:write\", \"doc:1\", \"alice-draft-1\");\ntxn.stageWrite(\"alice\", \"doc:write\", \"doc:2\", \"alice-draft-2\");\nlog(`== t2 会话 ${sAlice.id} 绑定快照 v${sAlice.boundVersion}，长事务暂存 2 条写 ==`);\n\n// t3: 撤销 alice 的写权限，发布 v2\npolicies.publish({\n  alice: [\"doc:read\"],\n  bob: [\"doc:read\", \"doc:write\"],\n});\nlog(\"== t3 管理员撤销 alice:doc:write，发布策略 v2 ==\");\n\n// t4: 长事务期间，旧会话仍读到旧权限（旧命中证据）\nlog(`== t4 旧会话读权限（快照 v${sAlice.boundVersion}）==`);\nlog(`  旧命中: S-alice.can(alice, doc:write) = ${sAlice.can(\"alice\", \"doc:write\")}  (快照 v${sAlice.boundVersion} 仍允许)`);\nlog(`  旧命中: S-alice.can(alice, doc:read)  = ${sAlice.can(\"alice\", \"doc:read\")}`);\n\n// t5: 新会话绑定 v2，读权限命中新策略（新命中证据）\nconst sAlice2 = policies.openSession(\"S2-alice\");\nlog(`== t5 新会话 S2-alice 绑定快照 v${sAlice2.boundVersion} ==`);\nlog(`  新命中: S2-alice.can(alice, doc:write) = ${sAlice2.can(\"alice\", \"doc:write\")}  (最新 v${sAlice2.boundVersion} 已撤销)`);\n\n// t6: 长事务提交 —— 按最新版本重核全部写动作\nlog(\"== t6 长事务提交：按最新版本 v2 重核全部写动作 ==\");\nconst result = txn.commit(data);\nlog(formatEvidence(result));\nlog(`  数据库键集合: [${data.keys().join(\", \")}]  <- 全不提交，保持为空`);\n\n// t7: 新会话提交 bob 的写（v2 下仍允许）\nlog(\"== t7 新会话提交 bob 的写（v2 下仍允许）==\");\nconst sBob = policies.openSession(\"S-bob\");\nconst txnBob = sBob.begin();\ntxnBob.stageWrite(\"bob\", \"doc:write\", \"doc:9\", \"bob-final\");\nconst bobResult = txnBob.commit(data);\nlog(formatEvidence(bobResult));\nlog(`  数据库键集合: [${data.keys().join(\", \")}]  <- bob 的写正常落库`);\n\nlog(\"== 模拟结束 ==\");\n"

{\n  alice: [\"doc:read\"], // 撤销 doc:write\n  bob: [\"doc:read\", \"doc:write\"],\n} as const;\n\ndescribe(\"会话快照绑定\", () => {\n  test(\"会话打开时绑定当前版本，之后发布新版本不影响旧会话的读\", () => {\n    const policies = new PolicyStore(V1_GRANTS);\n    const session = policies.openSession(\"s1\");\n    assert.equal(session.boundVersion, 1);\n\n    policies.publish(V2_GRANTS);\n\n    // 旧会话仍按 v1 判定：旧命中\n    assert.equal(session.boundVersion, 1);\n    assert.equal(session.can(\"alice\", \"doc:write\"), true);\n    // 新会话按 v2 判定：新命中\n    const fresh = policies.openSession(\"s2\");\n    assert.equal(fresh.boundVersion, 2);\n    assert.equal(fresh.can(\"alice\", \"doc:write\"), false);\n  });\n\n  test(\"长事务期间旧会话可继续读旧权限，新会话读被新策略拦截\", () => {\n    const policies = new PolicyStore(V1_GRANTS);\n    const longSession = policies.openSession(\"long\");\n    const txn = longSession.begin();\n    txn.stageWrite(\"alice\", \"doc:write\", \"doc:1\", \"draft\");\n\n    policies.publish(V2_GRANTS);\n\n    // 长事务中：旧权限判定仍然放行\n    assert.equal(longSession.can(\"alice\", \"doc:write\"), true);\n    // 新会话：暂存同样的写会被 v2 直接拒绝\n    const freshTxn = AuthzError).version === 2,\n    );\n    txn.abort();\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe(\"提交重核\", () => {\n  test(\"提交按最新版本重核全部写动作：撤销命中则全不提交\", () => {\n    const policies = new PolicyStore(V1_GRANTS);\n    const data = new DataStore();\n\n    const session = policies.openSession(\"s-alice\");\n    const txn = session.begin();\n    txn.stageWrite(\"alice\", \"doc:write\", \"doc:1\", \"a1\");\n \"aborted\");\n    assert.equal(result.sessionVersion, 1);\n    assert.equal(result.latestVersion, 2);\n    // 全不提交：数据库保持为空\n    assert.deepEqual(data.keys(), []);\n    assert.equal(data.get(\"doc:1\"), undefined);\n    assert.equal(data.get(\"doc:2\"), undefined);\n    // 撤销命中证据：旧允许 -> 新拒绝\n    assert.equal(result.revocationHits.length, 2);\n    for (const hit of result.revocationHits) {\n      assert.equal(hit.sessionDecision, \"allow\");\n      assert.equal(hit.latestDecision, \"deny\");\n      assert.equal(hit.outcome, \"aborted\");\n    }\n  });\n\n  test(\"原子性：混合事务中一条被撤销，全部写都不落库\", () => {\n    const policies = new PolicyStore(V1_GRANTS);\n    const data = new DataStore();\n\n    const session = policies.openSession(\"s-mixed\");\n    const txn = session.begin();\n    txn.stageWrite(\"alice\", \"doc:write\", \"doc:1\", \"a1\"); // 将被 v2 撤销\n    txn.stageWrite(\"bob\", \"doc:write\", \"doc:2\", \"b2\"); // v2 下仍允许\n\n    policies.publish(V2_GRANTS);\n    const result = txn.commit(data);\n\n    assert.equal(result.status, \"aborted\");\n    // bob 的写在新版本下是允许的，但因同事务 alice 的写被拒，也一并中止\n    const bobEvidence = result.evidence.find((e) => e.subject === \"bob\");\n    assert.equal(bobEvidence?.latestDecision, \"allow\");\n    assert.equal(bobEvidence?.outcome, \"aborted\");\n    assert.deepEqual(data.keys(), []);\n  });\n\n  test(\"无撤销时提交成功，全部写落库，证据为 旧允许->新允许\", () => {\n    const policies = new PolicyStore(V1_GRANTS);\n    const data = new DataStore();\n\n    const session = assert.equal(result.revocationHits.length, 0);\n    assert.equal(result.evidence[0]?.sessionDecision, \"allow\");\n    assert.equal(result.evidence[0]?.latestDecision, \"allow\");\n    assert.equal(result.evidence[0]?.outcome, \"committed\");\n  });\n\n  test(\"重核用的是提交时刻的最新版本，而非会话绑定版本\", () => {\n    const policies = new PolicyStore(V1_GRANTS);\n    const data = new DataStore();\n\n    const session = policies.openSession(\"s1\"); // 绑定 v1\n    const txn = session.begin();\n    txn.stageWrite(\"alice\", \"doc:write\", \"doc:1\", \"a1\");\n\n    policies.publish(V2_GRANTS); // v2 assert.equal(data.get(\"doc:1\"), \"a1\");\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe(\"证据输出\", () => {\n  test(\"formatEvidence 输出旧/新命中明细\", () => {\n    const policies = new PolicyStore(V1_GRANTS);\n    const data = formatEvidence(txn.commit(data));\n\n    assert.ok(text.includes(\"旧版本v1=allow -> 新版本v2=deny\"));\n    assert.ok(text.includes(\"撤销命中 1 条\"));\n    assert.ok(text.includes(\"已中止\"));\n  });\n});\n"

'none';\n  const forgedValue = data.get('forged') ?? B 探针完整输入文件 .probe-build/dist/src/evidence.js以 JSON 字符串记录，解码后可还原完整输入文件："/** 命中证据：每一次鉴权判定都留下一条可追溯记录。 */\nexport class EvidenceLog {\n    entries = [];\n    record(entry) {\n        const full = { seq: this.entries.length + 1, ...entry };\n        this.entries.push(full);\n        return full;\n    }\n    all() {\n        return this.entries;\n    }\n    /** 旧版本命中：判定用了落后于最新版本的快照且放行 */\n    staleHits() {\n        return this.entries.filter((e) => e.checkedVersion < e.latestVersion && e.decision === \"allow\");\n    }\n    /** 新版本命中/拦截：提交重核阶段的判定 */\n    rechecks() {\n        return this.entries.filter((e) => e.phase === \"commit-recheck\");\n    }\n    render() {\n        const lines = this.entries.map((e) => {\n            const stale = e.checkedVersion < e.latestVersion ? \" [旧快照]\" : \"\";\n            return (`#${String(e.seq).padStart(2)} ${e.phase.padEnd(14)} ` +\n                `${e.subject} ${e.action} ${e.resource} -> ${e.decision.toUpperCase()} ` +\n                `(判定版本 v${e.checkedVersion}, 最新 v${e.latestVersion})${stale} ${e.note}`);\n        });\n        return lines.join(\"\\n\");\n    }\n}\n"

B 探针完整输入文件 .probe-build/dist/src/index.js以 JSON 字符串记录，解码后可还原完整输入文件："export { EvidenceLog } from \"./evidence.js\";\nexport { PolicyStore } from \"./policy.js\";\nexport { DataStore } from \"./store.js\";\nexport { AuthorizationError, Session, Transaction, openSession, } from \"./session.js\";\n"

B 探针完整输入文件 .probe-build/dist/src/policy.js以 JSON 字符串记录，解码后可还原完整输入文件："/**\n * 版本化策略库：每次授权/撤销产生一个不可变新版本，\n * 历史版本永久保留，供已绑定旧版本的会话快照继续判定。\n */\nfunction keyOf(p) {\n    return `${p.subject}|${p.action}|${p.resource}`;\n}\nexport class PolicyStore {\n    /** version -> 该版本的权限集合（不可变快照） */\n    versions = new Map();\n    currentVersion = 0;\n    constructor() {\n        this.versions.set(0, new Set());\n    }\n    get latestVersion() {\n        return this.currentVersion;\n    }\n    hasVersion(version) {\n        return this.versions.has(version);\n    }\n    grant(permission) {\n        return this.mutate((next) => next.add(keyOf(permission)));\n    }\n    revoke(permission) {\n        return this.mutate((next) => next.delete(keyOf(permission)));\n    }\n    mutate(fn) {\n        const next = new Set(this.versions.get(this.currentVersion));\n        fn(next);\n        this.currentVersion += 1;\n        this.versions.set(this.currentVersion, next);\n        return this.currentVersion;\n    }\n    /** 按指定版本判定；缺省用最新版本。 */\n    allows(permission, version) {\n        const v = version ?? this.currentVersion;\n        const snapshot = this.versions.get(v);\n        if (snapshot === undefined) {\n            throw new RangeError(`unknown policy version v${v}`);\n        }\n        return snapshot.has(keyOf(permission));\n    }\n}\n"

B 探针完整输入文件 .probe-build/dist/src/session.js以 JSON 字符串记录，解码后可还原完整输入文件："export class AuthorizationError extends Error {\n    checkedVersion;\n    constructor(message, checkedVersion) {\n        super(message);\n        this.checkedVersion = checkedVersion;\n        this.name = \"AuthorizationError\";\n    }\n}\n/**\n * 会话：创建时绑定策略版本快照。\n * 会话内所有读/写缓冲判定都使用该绑定版本，\n * 即使策略库已推进到更新的版本。\n */\nexport class Session {\n    subject;\n    boundVersion;\n    policy;\n    store;\n    log;\n    constructor(subject, boundVersion, policy, store, log) {\n        this.subject = subject;\n        this.boundVersion = boundVersion;\n        this.policy = policy;\n        this.store = store;\n        this.log = log;\n    }\n    beginTransaction() {\n        return new Transaction(this, this.policy, this.store, this.log);\n    }\n}\nexport class Transaction {\n    session;\n    policy;\n    store;\n    log;\n    staged = [];\n    closed = false;\n    constructor(session, policy, store, log) {\n        this.session = session;\n        this.policy = policy;\n        this.store = store;\n        this.log = log;\n    }\n    /** 长事务读：按会话绑定的（可能已过期的）快照版本判定。 */\n    read(resource) {\n        this.assertOpen();\n        const allowed = this.policy.allows({ subject: this.session.subject, action: \"read\", resource }, this.session.boundVersion);\n        this.log.record({\n            phase: \"read\",\n            subject: this.session.subject,\n            action: \"read\",\n            resource,\n            checkedVersion: this.session.boundVersion,\n            latestVersion: this.policy.latestVersion,\n            decision: allowed ? \"allow\" : \"deny\",\n            note: allowed ? \"快照放行\" : \"快照拒绝\",\n        });\n        if (!allowed) {\n            throw new AuthorizationError(`read ${resource} denied at snapshot v${this.session.boundVersion}`, this.session.boundVersion);\n        }\n        return this.store.get(resource);\n    }\n    /** 写动作入缓冲：按快照版本乐观判定，真正生效推迟到提交重核。 */\n    write(resource, value) {\n        this.assertOpen();\n        const allowed = this.policy.allows({ subject: this.session.subject, action: \"write\", resource }, this.session.boundVersion);\n        this.log.record({\n            phase: \"write-stage\",\n            subject: this.session.subject,\n            action: \"write\",\n            resource,\n            checkedVersion: this.session.boundVersion,\n            latestVersion: this.policy.latestVersion,\n            decision: allowed ? \"allow\" : \"deny\",\n            note: allowed ? \"快照放行，进入缓冲\" : \"快照拒绝\",\n        });\n        if (!allowed) {\n            throw new AuthorizationError(`write ${resource} denied at snapshot v${this.session.boundVersion}`, this.session.boundVersion);\n        }\n        this.staged.push({\n            resource,\n            mutation: { resource, value },\n            stagedAtVersion: this.session.boundVersion,\n        });\n    }\n    /**\n     * 提交：用【最新】策略版本重核全部缓冲写动作。\n     * 任一失败则整体中止，一个写都不落库。\n     */\n    commit() {\n        this.assertOpen();\n        this.closed = true;\n        const recheckedVersion = this.policy.latestVersion;\n        const failures = [];\n        for (const s of this.staged) {\n            const allowed = this.policy.allows({ subject: this.session.subject, action: \"write\", resource: s.resource }, recheckedVersion);\n            this.log.record({\n                phase: \"commit-recheck\",\n                subject: this.session.subject,\n                action: \"write\",\n                resource: s.resource,\n                checkedVersion: recheckedVersion,\n                latestVersion: recheckedVersion,\n                decision: allowed ? \"allow\" : \"deny\",\n                note: allowed\n                    ? `重核通过 (缓冲时 v${s.stagedAtVersion})`\n                    : `重核拒绝：权限已在 v${recheckedVersion} 撤销 (缓冲时 v${s.stagedAtVersion} 放行)`,\n            });\n            if (!allowed) {\n                failures.push({\n                    resource: s.resource,\n                    reason: `write permission revoked before commit (rechecked at v${recheckedVersion})`,\n                });\n            }\n        }\n        if (failures.length > 0) {\n            // 失败全不提交：不落任何一条缓冲写。\n            return { status: \"aborted\", recheckedVersion, failures };\n        }\n        const applied = this.staged.map((s) => s.mutation);\n        this.store.applyAll(applied);\n        return { status: \"committed\", recheckedVersion, applied };\n    }\n    /** 放弃事务：缓冲写全部丢弃。 */\n    rollback() {\n        this.closed = true;\n        this.staged.length = 0;\n    }\n    assertOpen() {\n        if (this.closed) {\n            throw new Error(\"transaction already closed\");\n        }\n    }\n}\n/** 打开一个会话：绑定当前最新策略版本作为快照。 */\nexport function openSession(subject, policy, store, log) {\n    return new Session(subject, policy.latestVersion, policy, store, log);\n}\n"

B 探针完整输入文件 .probe-build/dist/src/simulate.js以 JSON 字符串记录，解码后可还原完整输入文件："/**\n * 模拟：策略撤销与长事务提交交错。\n *\n * 时间线：\n *   t1  策略 v1：alice 获得 doc/A、doc/B 的 read+write\n *   t2  alice 打开会话 S（快照绑定 v1），开始长事务 T\n *   t3  T 读 doc/A、doc/B            —— 按 v1 判定（命中旧权限）\n *   t4  T 缓冲写 doc/A、doc/B        —— 按 v1 乐观放行\n *   t5  管理员撤销 alice 对 doc/B 的写权限  => 策略推进到 v2\n *   t6  T 继续读 doc/B               —— 仍按 v1 放行（旧快照命中证据）\n *   t7  T 提交                       —— 按 v2 重核：doc/A 过、doc/B 拒\n *                                    —— 整体中止，一条都不落库\n *   t8  alice 重开会话（绑定 v2），只写 doc/A，提交成功（新版本命中证据）\n */\nimport { DataStore, EvidenceLog, PolicyStore, openSession } from \"./index.js\";\nfunction banner(title) {\n    console.log(`\\n=== ${title} ===`);\n}\nconst policy = new PolicyStore();\nconst store = new DataStore();\nconst log = new EvidenceLog();\nbanner(\"t1 授权：alice -> read/write doc/A, doc/B（策略推进到 v4）\");\npolicy.grant({ subject: \"alice\", action: \"read\", resource: \"doc/A\" });\npolicy.grant({ subject: \"alice\", action: \"write\", resource: \"doc/A\" });\npolicy.grant({ subject: \"alice\", action: \"read\", resource: \"doc/B\" });\npolicy.grant({ subject: \"alice\", action: \"write\", resource: \"doc/B\" });\nconsole.log(`latest policy version = v${policy.latestVersion}`);\nbanner(\"t2 打开长事务会话（快照绑定当前版本）\");\nconst session = openSession(\"alice\", policy, store, log);\nconsole.log(`session bound to snapshot v${session.boundVersion}`);\nconst tx = session.beginTransaction();\nbanner(\"t3 长事务读（按绑定快照判定）\");\nconsole.log(`read doc/A => ${tx.read(\"doc/A\") ?? \"(empty)\"}`);\nconsole.log(`read doc/B => ${tx.read(\"doc/B\") ?? \"(empty)\"}`);\nbanner(\"t4 缓冲写动作（按快照乐观放行，未落库）\");\ntx.write(\"doc/A\", \"A-written-by-long-tx\");\ntx.write(\"doc/B\", \"B-written-by-long-tx\");\nconsole.log(`staged 2 writes; store still: ${JSON.stringify(store.entries())}`);\nbanner(\"t5 管理员撤销 alice 对 doc/B 的写权限（策略 v4 -> v5）\");\npolicy.revoke({ subject: \"alice\", action: \"write\", resource: \"doc/B\" });\nconsole.log(`latest policy version = v${policy.latestVersion}`);\nbanner(\"t6 长事务继续读 doc/B（旧快照仍放行）\");\nconsole.log(`read doc/B => ${tx.read(\"doc/B\") ?? \"(empty)\"}`);\nbanner(\"t7 提交：按最新版本重核全部缓冲写，失败则全不提交\");\nconst result = tx.commit();\nconsole.log(`commit status = ${result.status} (rechecked at v${result.recheckedVersion})`);\nif (result.status === \"aborted\") {\n    for (const f of result.failures) {\n        console.log(`  failure: ${f.resource} - ${f.reason}`);\n    }\n}\nconsole.log(`store after abort = ${JSON.stringify(store.entries())} (应为空：一条都不落库)`);\nbanner(\"t8 重开会话（绑定 v5），只写 doc/A，提交成功\");\nconst session2 = openSession(\"alice\", policy, store, log);\nconsole.log(`session bound to snapshot v${session2.boundVersion}`);\nconst tx2 = session2.beginTransaction();\ntx2.write(\"doc/A\", \"A-committed-under-v5\");\nconst result2 = tx2.commit();\nconsole.log(`commit status = ${result2.status} (rechecked at v${result2.recheckedVersion})`);\nconsole.log(`store = ${JSON.stringify(store.entries())}`);\nbanner(\"命中证据（全部判定记录）\");\nconsole.log(log.render());\nbanner(\"旧快照命中（判定版本落后于最新版本且放行）\");\nfor (const e of log.staleHits()) {\n    console.log(`  #${e.seq} ${e.phase} ${e.action} ${e.resource}: 用 v${e.checkedVersion} 放行，当时最新已是 v${e.latestVersion}`);\n}\nbanner(\"提交重核（新版本判定）\");\nfor (const e of log.rechecks()) {\n    console.log(`  #${e.seq} ${e.action} ${e.resource}: v${e.checkedVersion} -> ${e.decision.toUpperCase()} ${e.note}`);\n}\n"

B 探针完整输入文件 .probe-build/dist/src/store.js以 JSON 字符串记录，解码后可还原完整输入文件："/** 数据存储：只有提交重核全部通过后，写动作才会落到这里。 */\nexport class DataStore {\n    data = new Map();\n    get(resource) {\n        return this.data.get(resource);\n    }\n    /** 原子应用：调用方必须保证整批写动作已通过最新版本重核。 */\n    applyAll(mutations) {\n        for (const m of mutations) {\n            this.data.set(m.resource, m.value);\n        }\n    }\n    entries() {\n        return Object.fromEntries(this.data);\n    }\n}\n"

DataStore, EvidenceLog, PolicyStore, openSession, } from \"../src/index.js\";\nfunction fixture() {\n    const policy = new PolicyStore();\n    const store = new DataStore();\n    const log = new EvidenceLog();\n    policy.grant({ subject: \"alice\", action: \"read\", resource: \"doc/A\" });\n    policy.grant({ subject: \"alice\", action: \"write\", resource: \"doc/A\" });\n    policy.grant({ subject: \"alice\", action: \"read\", resource: \"doc/B\" });\n    policy.grant({ subject: \"alice\", action: \"write\", resource: \"doc/B\" });\n    return { policy, store, log };\n}\ndescribe(\"快照绑定\", () => {\n    test(\"会话绑定创建时的策略版本\", () => {\n        const { policy, store, log } = fixture();\n        const session = openSession(\"alice\", policy, store, log);\n        assert.equal(session.boundVersion, policy.latestVersion);\n        policy.revoke({ subject: \"alice\", action: \"write\", resource: \"doc/B\" });\n        assert.equal(session.boundVersion, policy.latestVersion - 1);\n    });\n    test(\"长事务读在权限被撤销后仍按旧快照放行\", () => {\n        const { policy, store, log } = fixture();\n        const session = openSession(\"alice\", policy, store, log);\n        const tx = session.beginTransaction();\n        policy.revoke({ subject: \"alice\", action: \"read\", resource: \"doc/B\" });\n        assert.doesNotThrow(() => tx.read(\"doc/B\"));\n        const hit = log.all().at(-1);\n        assert.equal(hit?.decision, \"allow\");\n        assert.equal(hit?.checkedVersion, session.boundVersion);\n        assert.ok(hit !== undefined && hit.checkedVersion < hit.latestVersion);\n    });\n    test(\"新会话绑定最新版本，已撤销的读权限立即被拒\", () => {\n        const { policy, store, log } = fixture();\n        policy.revoke({ subject: \"alice\", action: \"read\", resource: \"doc/B\" });\n        const session = openSession(\"alice\", policy, store, log);\n        const tx = session.beginTransaction();\n        assert.throws(() => tx.read(\"doc/B\"), AuthorizationError);\n    });\n});\ndescribe(\"提交重核\", () => {\n    test(\"提交按最新版本重核：撤销写权限后整体中止，一条都不落库\", () => {\n        const { policy, store, log } = fixture();\n        const session = openSession(\"alice\", policy, store, log);\n        const tx = session.beginTransaction();\n        tx.write(\"doc/A\", \"a1\"); // doc/A 写权限始终有效\n        tx.write(\"doc/B\", \"b1\"); // 缓冲时 v4 放行\n === \"aborted\") {\n            assert.equal(result.recheckedVersion, policy.latestVersion);\n            assert.deepEqual(result.failures.map((f) => f.resource), [\"doc/B\"]);\n        }\n        // 失败全不提交：连仍然合法的 doc/A 也不能落库\n        assert.deepEqual(store.entries(), {});\n    });\n    test(\"策略未变化时提交成功，全部写动作落库\", () => {\n        const { policy, store, log } = fixture();\n        const session = openSession(\"alice\", policy, store, log);\n        const tx = session.beginTransaction();\n        tx.write(\"doc/A\", \"a1\");\n        tx.write(\"doc/B\", \"b1\");\n        const result = tx.commit();\n        assert.equal(result.status, \"committed\");\n        assert.deepEqual(store.entries(), { \"doc/A\": \"a1\", \"doc/B\": \"b1\" });\n    });\n    test(\"撤销与提交交错：重开后只写仍被允许的资源可提交\", tx1.write(\"doc/B\", \"b1\");\n        policy.revoke({ subject: \"alice\", action: \"write\", resource: \"doc/B\" });\n        assert.equal(tx1.commit().status, \"aborted\");\n        const tx2 = assert.deepEqual(store.entries(), { \"doc/A\": \"a2\" });\n    });\n    test(\"缓冲阶段即被快照拒绝的写直接抛错，不进入重核\", () => {\n        const { policy, store, log } = fixture();\n        const session = () => {\n        const { policy, store, log } = fixture();\n        const session = openSession(\"alice\", policy, store, log);\n        const tx = session.beginTransaction();\n        tx.read(\"doc/B\");\n        tx.write(\"doc/B\", \"b1\");\n        policy.revoke({ subject: \"alice\", action: \"write\", resource: \"doc/B\" });\n        tx.read(\"doc/B\"); // 旧快照命中\n        tx.commit();\n        const stale = log.staleHits();\n        assert.ok(stale.length >= 1);\n        assert.ok(stale.every((e) => e.checkedVersion < e.latestVersion));\n        const rechecks = log.rechecks();\n        assert.equal(rechecks.length, 1);\n        assert.equal(rechecks[0]?.decision, \"deny\");\n        assert.equal(rechecks[0]?.checkedVersion, policy.latestVersion);\n    });\n});\ndescribe(\"边界行为\", () => {\n    test(\"按未知版本判定抛 RangeError\", () => {\n        const { policy } = fixture();\n        assert.throws(() => policy.allows({ subject: \"a\", action: \"read\", resource: \"r\" }, 999), RangeError);\n    });\n    test(\"事务关闭后禁止再读写\", () => {\n        const { policy, store, log } = fixture();\n        const tx = openSession(\"alice\", policy, store, log).beginTransaction();\n        tx.rollback();\n        assert.throws(() => tx.read(\"doc/A\"), /already closed/);\n        assert.throws(() => tx.write(\"doc/A\", \"x\"), /already closed/);\n B 探针完整输入文件 .probe-build/src/evidence.ts以 JSON 字符串记录，解码后可还原完整输入文件："/** 命中证据：每一次鉴权判定都留下一条可追溯记录。 */\n\nexport type Phase =\n  | \"read\" // 长事务内读：按会话绑定的快照版本判定\n  | \"write-stage\" // 写动作入缓冲：按快照版本做乐观判定\n  | \"commit-recheck\"; // 提交时：按最新策略版本重核全部写动作\n\nexport type Decision = \"allow\" | \"deny\";\n\nexport interface Evidence {\n  seq: number;\n  phase: Phase;\n  subject: string;\n  action: string;\n  resource: string;\n  /** 本次判定实际使用的策略版本 */\n  checkedVersion: number;\n  /** 判定发生时的最新策略版本 */\n  latestVersion: number;\n  decision: Decision;\n  note: string;\n}\n\nexport class EvidenceLog {\n  private entries: Evidence[] = [];\n\n  record(entry: Omit<Evidence, \"seq\">): Evidence {\n    const full: Evidence = { seq: this.entries.length + 1, ...entry };\n    this.entries.push(full);\n    return full;\n  }\n\n  all(): readonly Evidence[] {\n    return this.entries;\n  }\n\n  /** 旧版本命中：判定用了落后于最新版本的快照且放行 */\n  staleHits(): Evidence[] {\n    return this.entries.filter(\n      (e) => e.checkedVersion < e.latestVersion && e.decision === \"allow\",\n    );\n  }\n\n  /** 新版本命中/拦截：提交重核阶段的判定 */\n  rechecks(): Evidence[] {\n    return this.entries.filter((e) => e.phase === \"commit-recheck\");\n  }\n\n  render(): string {\n    const lines = this.entries.map((e) => {\n      const stale = e.checkedVersion < e.latestVersion ? \" [旧快照]\" : \"\";\n      return (\n        `#${String(e.seq).padStart(2)} ${e.phase.padEnd(14)} ` +\n        `${e.subject} ${e.action} ${e.resource} -> ${e.decision.toUpperCase()} ` +\n        `(判定版本 v${e.checkedVersion}, 最新 v${e.latestVersion})${stale} ${e.note}`\n      );\n    });\n    return lines.join(\"\\n\");\n  }\n}\n"

B 探针完整输入文件 .probe-build/src/policy.ts以 JSON 字符串记录，解码后可还原完整输入文件："/**\n * 版本化策略库：每次授权/撤销产生一个不可变新版本，\n * 历史版本永久保留，供已绑定旧版本的会话快照继续判定。\n */\n\nexport type Action = \"read\" | \"write\";\n\nexport interface Permission {\n  subject: string;\n  action: Action;\n  resource: string;\n}\n\nfunction keyOf(p: Permission): string {\n  return `${p.subject}|${p.action}|${p.resource}`;\n}\n\nexport class PolicyStore {\n  /** version -> 该版本的权限集合（不可变快照） */\n  private readonly versions = new Map<number, ReadonlySet<string>>();\n  private currentVersion = 0;\n\n  constructor() {\n    this.versions.set(0, new Set());\n  }\n\n  get latestVersion(): number {\n    return this.currentVersion;\n  }\n\n  hasVersion(version: number): boolean {\n    return this.versions.has(version);\n  }\n\n  grant(permission: Permission): number {\n    return this.mutate((next) => next.add(keyOf(permission)));\n  }\n\n  revoke(permission: Permission): number {\n    return this.mutate((next) => next.delete(keyOf(permission)));\n  }\n\n  private mutate(fn: (next: Set<string>) => void): number {\n    const next = new Set(this.versions.get(this.currentVersion));\n    fn(next);\n    this.currentVersion += 1;\n    this.versions.set(this.currentVersion, next);\n    return this.currentVersion;\n  }\n\n  /** 按指定版本判定；缺省用最新版本。 */\n  allows(permission: Permission, version?: number): boolean {\n    const v = version ?? this.currentVersion;\n    const snapshot = this.versions.get(v);\n    if (snapshot === undefined) {\n      throw new RangeError(`unknown policy version v${v}`);\n    }\n    return snapshot.has(keyOf(permission));\n  }\n}\n"

B 探针完整输入文件 .probe-build/src/session.ts以 JSON 字符串记录，解码后可还原完整输入文件："import { EvidenceLog } from \"./evidence.js\";\nimport { PolicyStore } from \"./policy.js\";\nimport { DataStore, Mutation } from \"./store.js\";\n\nexport class AuthorizationError extends Error {\n  constructor(\n    message: string,\n    readonly checkedVersion: number,\n  ) {\n    super(message);\n    this.name = \"AuthorizationError\";\n  }\n}\n\nexport interface StagedWrite {\n  resource: string;\n  mutation: Mutation;\n  /** 入缓冲时乐观判定所用的快照版本 */\n  stagedAtVersion: number;\n}\n\nexport interface CommitFailure {\n  resource: string;\n  reason: string;\n}\n\nexport type CommitResult =\n  | { status: \"committed\"; recheckedVersion: number; applied: Mutation[] }\n  | { status: \"aborted\"; recheckedVersion: number; failures: CommitFailure[] };\n\n/**\n * 会话：创建时绑定策略版本快照。\n * 会话内所有读/写缓冲判定都使用该绑定版本，\n * 即使策略库已推进到更新的版本。\n */\nexport class Session {\n  constructor(\n    readonly subject: string,\n    readonly boundVersion: number,\n    private readonly policy: PolicyStore,\n    private readonly store: DataStore,\n    private readonly log: EvidenceLog,\n  ) {}\n\n  beginTransaction(): Transaction {\n    return new Transaction(this, this.policy, this.store, this.log);\n  }\n}\n\nexport class Transaction {\n  private readonly staged: StagedWrite[] = [];\n  private closed = false;\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly session: Session,\n    private readonly policy: PolicyStore,\n    private readonly store: DataStore,\n    private readonly log: EvidenceLog,\n  ) {}\n\n  /** 长事务读：按会话绑定的（可能已过期的）快照版本判定。 */\n  read(resource: string): string | undefined {\n    this.assertOpen();\n    const allowed = this.policy.allows(\n      { subject: this.session.subject, action: \"read\", resource },\n      this.session.boundVersion,\n    );\n    this.log.record({\n      phase: \"read\",\n      subject: this.session.subject,\n      action: \"read\",\n      resource,\n      checkedVersion: this.session.boundVersion,\n      latestVersion: this.policy.latestVersion,\n      decision: allowed ? \"allow\" : \"deny\",\n      note: allowed ? \"快照放行\" : \"快照拒绝\",\n    });\n    if (!allowed) {\n      throw new AuthorizationError(\n        `read ${resource} denied at snapshot v${this.session.boundVersion}`,\n        this.session.boundVersion,\n      );\n    }\n    return this.store.get(resource);\n  }\n\n  /** 写动作入缓冲：按快照版本乐观判定，真正生效推迟到提交重核。 */\n  write(resource: string, value: string): void {\n    this.assertOpen();\n    const allowed = this.policy.allows(\n      { subject: this.session.subject, action: \"write\", resource },\n      this.session.boundVersion,\n    );\n    this.log.record({\n      phase: \"write-stage\",\n      subject: this.session.subject,\n      action: \"write\",\n      resource,\n      checkedVersion: this.session.boundVersion,\n      latestVersion: this.policy.latestVersion,\n      decision: allowed ? \"allow\" : \"deny\",\n      note: allowed ? \"快照放行，进入缓冲\" : \"快照拒绝\",\n    });\n    if (!allowed) {\n      throw new AuthorizationError(\n        `write ${resource} denied at snapshot v${this.session.boundVersion}`,\n        this.session.boundVersion,\n      );\n    }\n    this.staged.push({\n      resource,\n      mutation: { resource, value },\n      stagedAtVersion: this.session.boundVersion,\n    });\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 提交：用【最新】策略版本重核全部缓冲写动作。\n   * 任一失败则整体中止，一个写都不落库。\n   */\n  commit(): CommitResult {\n    this.assertOpen();\n    this.closed = true;\n    const recheckedVersion = this.policy.latestVersion;\n    const failures: CommitFailure[] = [];\n\n    for (const s of this.staged) {\n      const allowed = this.policy.allows(\n        { subject: this.session.subject, action: \"write\", resource: s.resource },\n        recheckedVersion,\n      );\n      this.log.record({\n        phase: \"commit-recheck\",\n        subject: this.session.subject,\n        action: \"write\",\n        resource: s.resource,\n        checkedVersion: recheckedVersion,\n        latestVersion: recheckedVersion,\n        decision: allowed ? \"allow\" : \"deny\",\n        note: allowed\n          ? `重核通过 (缓冲时 v${s.stagedAtVersion})`\n          : `重核拒绝：权限已在 v${recheckedVersion} 撤销 (缓冲时 v${s.stagedAtVersion} 放行)`,\n      });\n      if (!allowed) {\n        failures.push({\n          resource: s.resource,\n          reason: `write permission revoked before commit (rechecked at v${recheckedVersion})`,\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (failures.length > 0) {\n      // 失败全不提交：不落任何一条缓冲写。\n      return { status: \"aborted\", recheckedVersion, failures };\n    }\n\n    const applied = this.staged.map((s) => s.mutation);\n    this.store.applyAll(applied);\n    return { status: \"committed\", recheckedVersion, applied };\n  }\n\n  /** 放弃事务：缓冲写全部丢弃。 */\n  rollback(): void {\n    this.closed = true;\n    this.staged.length = 0;\n  }\n\n  private assertOpen(): void {\n    if (this.closed) {\n      throw new Error(\"transaction already closed\");\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n/** 打开一个会话：绑定当前最新策略版本作为快照。 */\nexport function openSession(\n  subject: string,\n  policy: PolicyStore,\n  store: DataStore,\n  log: EvidenceLog,\n): Session {\n  return new Session(subject, policy.latestVersion, policy, store, log);\n}\n"

\"(empty)\"}`);\nconsole.log(`read doc/B => ${tx.read(\"doc/B\") ?? \"(empty)\"}`);\n\nbanner(\"t4 缓冲写动作（按快照乐观放行，未落库）\");\ntx.write(\"doc/A\", \"A-written-by-long-tx\");\ntx.write(\"doc/B\", \"B-written-by-long-tx\");\nconsole.log(`staged 2 writes; store still: ${JSON.stringify(store.entries())}`);\n\nbanner(\"t5 管理员撤销 alice 对 doc/B 的写权限（策略 v4 -> v5）\");\npolicy.revoke({ subject: \"alice\", action: \"write\", resource: \"doc/B\" });\nconsole.log(`latest policy version = v${policy.latestVersion}`);\n\nbanner(\"t6 长事务继续读 doc/B（旧快照仍放行）\");\nconsole.log(`read doc/B => ${tx.read(\"doc/B\") ?? \"(empty)\"}`);\n\nbanner(\"t7 提交：按最新版本重核全部缓冲写，失败则全不提交\");\nconst result = tx.commit();\nconsole.log(`commit status = ${result.status} (rechecked at v${result.recheckedVersion})`);\nif (result.status === \"aborted\") {\n  for (const f of result.failures) {\n    console.log(`  failure: ${f.resource} - ${f.reason}`);\n  }\n}\nconsole.log(`store after abort = ${JSON.stringify(store.entries())} (应为空：一条都不落库)`);\n\nbanner(\"t8 重开会话（绑定 v5），只写 doc/A，提交成功\");\nconst session2 = openSession(\"alice\", policy, store, log);\nconsole.log(`session bound to snapshot v${session2.boundVersion}`);\nconst tx2 = session2.beginTransaction();\ntx2.write(\"doc/A\", \"A-committed-under-v5\");\nconst result2 = tx2.commit();\nconsole.log(`commit status = ${result2.status} (rechecked at v${result2.recheckedVersion})`);\nconsole.log(`store = ${JSON.stringify(store.entries())}`);\n\nbanner(\"命中证据（全部判定记录）\");\nconsole.log(log.render());\n\nbanner(\"旧快照命中（判定版本落后于最新版本且放行）\");\nfor (const e of log.staleHits()) {\n  console.log(`  #${e.seq} ${e.phase} ${e.action} ${e.resource}: 用 v${e.checkedVersion} 放行，当时最新已是 v${e.latestVersion}`);\n}\n\nbanner(\"提交重核（新版本判定）\");\nfor (const e of log.rechecks()) {\n  console.log(`  #${e.seq} ${e.action} ${e.resource}: v${e.checkedVersion} -> ${e.decision.toUpperCase()} ${e.note}`);\n}\n"

B 探针完整输入文件 .probe-build/src/store.ts以 JSON 字符串记录，解码后可还原完整输入文件："/** 数据存储：只有提交重核全部通过后，写动作才会落到这里。 */\n\nexport interface Mutation {\n  resource: string;\n  value: string;\n}\n\nexport class DataStore {\n  private readonly data = new Map<string, string>();\n\n  get(resource: string): string | undefined {\n    return this.data.get(resource);\n  }\n\n  /** 原子应用：调用方必须保证整批写动作已通过最新版本重核。 */\n  applyAll(mutations: readonly Mutation[]): void {\n    for (const m of mutations) {\n      this.data.set(m.resource, m.value);\n    }\n  }\n\n  entries(): Record<string, string> {\n    return Object.fromEntries(this.data);\n  }\n}\n"

DataStore,\n  EvidenceLog,\n  PolicyStore,\n  openSession,\n} from \"../src/index.js\";\n\nfunction fixture() {\n  const policy = new PolicyStore();\n  const store = new DataStore();\n  const log = };\n}\n\ndescribe(\"快照绑定\", () => {\n  test(\"会话绑定创建时的策略版本\", () => {\n    const { policy, store, log } = fixture();\n    const session = openSession(\"alice\", policy, store, log);\n \"committed\");\n    assert.deepEqual(store.entries(), { \"doc/A\": \"a1\", \"doc/B\": \"b1\" });\n  });\n\n  test(\"撤销与提交交错：重开后只写仍被允许的资源可提交\", () => {\n    const { policy, store, log } = fixture();\n    const tx1 = openSession(\"alice\", policy, store, log).beginTransaction();\n    tx1.write(\"doc/A\", \"a1\");\n    tx1.write(\"doc/B\", \"b1\");\n    policy.revoke({ subject: \"alice\", action: \"write\", resource: \"doc/B\" });\n    assert.equal(tx1.commit().status, \"aborted\");\n\n    const tx2 = openSession(\"alice\", policy, store, log).beginTransaction();\n    tx2.write(\"doc/A\", \"a2\");\n    const r2 = tx2.commit();\n    assert.equal(r2.status, \"committed\");\n    assert.deepEqual(store.entries(), { \"doc/A\": \"a2\" });\n  });\n\n  test(\"缓冲阶段即被快照拒绝的写直接抛错，不进入重核\", () => {\n    const { policy, store, log } = fixture();\n    const session = openSession(\"alice\", policy, store, log);\n    const tx = session.beginTransaction();\n    assert.throws(() => tx.write(\"doc/C\", \"nope\"), AuthorizationError);\n    const result = tx.commit();\n    assert.equal(result.status, \"committed\"); // 无缓冲写，空提交成功\n    assert.deepEqual(store.entries(), {});\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe(\"命中证据\", () => {\n  test(\"记录旧快照命中与新版本重核判定\", () => {\n    const { policy, store, log } = fixture();\n    const session = openSession(\"alice\", policy, store, log);\n    const tx = session.beginTransaction();\n    tx.read(\"doc/B\");\n    tx.write(\"doc/B\", \"b1\");\n    policy.revoke({ subject: \"alice\", action: \"write\", resource: \"doc/B\" });\n    tx.read(\"doc/B\"); // 旧快照命中\n    tx.commit();\n\n    const stale = log.staleHits();\n    assert.ok(stale.length >= 1);\n    assert.ok(stale.every((e) => e.checkedVersion < e.latestVersion));\n\n    const rechecks = log.rechecks();\n    assert.equal(rechecks.length, 1);\n    assert.equal(rechecks[0]?.decision, \"deny\");\n    assert.equal(rechecks[0]?.checkedVersion, policy.latestVersion);\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe(\"边界行为\", () => {\n  test(\"按未知版本判定抛 RangeError\", () => {\n    const { policy } = fixture();\n    assert.throws(\n      () => policy.allows({ subject: \"a\", action: \"read\", resource: \"r\" }, 999),\n      RangeError,\n    );\n  });\n\n  test(\"事务关闭后禁止再读写\", () => {\n    const { policy, store, log } = fixture();\n    const tx = openSession(\"alice\", policy, store, log).beginTransaction();\n    tx.rollback();\n    assert.throws(() => tx.read(\"doc/A\"), /already closed/);\n    assert.throws(() => tx.write(\"doc/A\", \"x\"), /already closed/);\n  });\n});\n"

B 探针完整输入文件 prepare.mjs以 JSON 字符串记录，解码后可还原完整输入文件："import { cpSync, mkdirSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs';\nimport { join, resolve } from 'node:path';\n\nconst source = resolve(process.argv[2] ?? '');\nconst target = resolve(import.meta.dirname, '.probe-build');\nif (!process.argv[2]) throw new Error('workspace path required');\nrmSync(target, { recursive: true, force: true });\nmkdirSync(target, { recursive: true });\nfor (const name of ['src', 'test', 'package.json', 'tsconfig.json']) {\n  cpSync(join(source, name), join(target, name), { recursive: true });\n}\nconsole.log(`源码副本已准备：${target}`);\n"

B 探针完整输入文件 probe-key-collision.mjs以 JSON 字符串记录，解码后可还原完整输入文件："import assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nimport { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';\nimport { resolve } from 'node:path';\n\nconst root = process.argv[2];\nassert.ok(root);\nconst lib = await import(pathToFileURL(resolve(root, 'dist/src/index.js')).href);\nconst policy = new lib.PolicyStore();\nconst granted = { subject: 'alice', action: 'read', resource: 'doc|write|x' };\nconst unintended = { subject: 'alice|read|doc', action: 'write', resource: 'x' };\npolicy.grant(granted);\nconst store = new lib.DataStore();\nconst log = new lib.EvidenceLog();\nconst tx = lib.openSession(unintended.subject, policy, store, log).beginTransaction();\ntx.write(unintended.resource, 'unexpected');\nconst result = tx.commit();\nconsole.log(JSON.stringify({ granted, unintended, decision: policy.allows(unintended), status: result.status, value: store.get('x'), evidence: log.all().map(e => [e.phase, e.decision]) }));\nassert.equal(result.status, 'committed');\nassert.equal(store.get('x'), 'unexpected');\nassert.equal(policy.allows(unintended), true);\nconsole.log(`摘要：非预期写权限=${policy.allows(unintended)}；提交=${result.status}；实际落库 x=${store.get('x')}`);\n"
